profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Experience working in academic, government and commercial aerospace organizations. Worked in the Satellite Attitude and Translation Control group on the Gravity Probe B program throughout the data acquisition and analysis mission phases. Developed satellite modeling and simulation software for NASA’s LADEE lunar orbiter. Worked in the Satellite Flight Software development and testing group at SSL. Developed ground software used to control a new fleet of Earth imaging satellites at Google.
